## SCUM Tactical Map & Chat Translator v2.4.1

### ⚠ Important for v2.4.0 users
v2.4.0 crashes at start-up (`'ScumLogParser' object has no attribute '_running'`), so it cannot update itself. **Download `SCUM_Chat_Translator.exe` (or the Portable one) from this release and replace the old file once.** Your settings, points and players are kept. Later updates are installed automatically again.

### Highlights
- 🛠 **Start-up crash fixed.** Releases are now built, started and self-tested in CI before they are published, and the in-app updater self-tests a downloaded build before replacing the current one.
- 🔁 **Safer updates:** the previous build is kept until the new one has run healthy for 10 minutes; a build that fails to start, or crashes twice in a row soon after starting, is rolled back automatically.
- 🗺 **Much smoother map:** panning and zooming with many pins no longer stutters or lowers the game's frame rate.
- ⚡ Importing thousands of waypoints no longer freezes the points window.

### Fixed
- Malformed coordinates in chat could crash the app; half-written log lines are no longer cut in two; changing the log path takes effect immediately; backlog replay no longer duplicates waypoints.
- Failed translations are no longer cached; the translation cache is bounded.
- `config.json`, `points.json`, `profiles.json`, `players.json` are written atomically; corrupt files are set aside instead of lost.
- Overlay no longer rebuilds the chat every 500 ms (scrolling works again); chat stays in order when translations finish out of order.
- `SCUM.log` is opened so the game can still rotate it; update errors, file filters and other texts are translated.
- Many smaller fixes in Settings, the update dialog, history export and the map (see the changelog).

### First launch
Windows SmartScreen may show "Windows protected your PC" the first time. This is normal for free unsigned apps and is **not** a virus warning: click **More info → Run anyway** once. Details in the [README](https://github.com/tankow79/scum-ui-translator-map#-windows-says-protected-your-pc--is-this-a-virus).

### Files
- `SCUM_Chat_Translator.exe`: standard build
- `SCUM_Chat_Translator_Portable.exe`: portable build
- `SCUM_Chat_Translator_v2.4.1.zip`: exe + instructions
